title: Persona cross-field validation for conflicting preferences

sections.what:
Add cross-field contradiction checks in `engine/character_appearance.py` that identify mutually exclusive items in character preferences:
- Overlap between `likes` and `dislikes`
- Overlap between `turn_ons` and `turn_offs`
- Overlap between `fears` and `kinks` (unless explicitly flagged as a fearplay trope)
sections.why: Characters authoring identical tags in both positive and negative preference arrays create erratic affect and dialogue generation where the LLM tries to simultaneously approach and avoid the same stimulus.
sections.how:
- Add `validate_persona_conflicts(persona_dict: dict) -> list[str]` in `engine/character_appearance.py`.
- Surface non-blocking warnings in the Persona inspector tab and compile preview modal.
- Add unit tests verifying conflict detection and warning outputs.

acceptance.text: Overlapping tags across polar pairs (`likes`/`dislikes`, `turn_ons`/`turn_offs`) emit validation warnings.
Conflicts are non-blocking in authoring but visible in the Persona UI.
Unit tests cover detection of conflicting tag entries.
